name: Create a GRE tunnel
description: Create a GRE tunnel Creates a new GRE tunnel. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/gre_tunnels
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/gre_tunnels
Creates a new GRE tunnel. Use `?validate_only=true` as an optional query parameter to only run validation without persisting changes.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: x-magic-new-hc-target (header) — If true, the health check target in the request and response bodies will be presented using the new object format. Defaults to false.
